purpose: Measure existing production slices before selecting optimizations; synthetic results cannot rank remote desktop products

sftp.timing: Monotonic wall time around the complete transfer call, excluding connect, generation and post-transfer hash verification
safetyGate: local download destination no overwrite only; remote upload collision NOT_EXERCISED
cancel interrupts held READ receive with witnessed local partial
sftp.timerSlackPolicy: Label excess observed timer delay without discarding trials or treating nominal delay as real RTT
sftp.diagnostic: Request counts and maximum outstanding responses; no SSH, network, peer disk or bandwidth emulator
sftp.futurePipelineComparison: NOT_SUPPORTED_BY_THIS_PEER: add calibrated bandwidth/serialization and out-of-order response modes before pipeline A/B; nominal timer delays alone cannot support a speedup claim
sftp.report: Raw repetitions and median/min/max; no p95/p99 from 5 transfers
sftp.optimizationDecision: A delay-sensitive plateau with one outstanding request justifies a bounded pipeline prototype; same OpenSSH real-host control and video fairness remain required before default enablement

input.timing: Pre-submit benchmark timestamp to in-memory peer acceptance; report latest and oldest pending separately
input.backendInstance: Inert fixture storage, production NativeBackend input extension/batcher/sender; not the actual app object
input.schedulePolicy: Profile names are target grids; report inter-arrival distribution and label lateness over20percent; do not discard slow/merged samples
safetyGate: barrier accepted exactly once and last, after final motion
input.report: Raw per-packet samples; per-run p95 only with at least100 packets; show merging and producer scheduling lateness

realHost.screenControl: DeskBridge and Moonlight sequentially on the same Sunshine/configuration
realHost.fileControl: DeskBridge and Cyberduck on the same OpenSSH account and new synthetic folder
realHost.unknownPolicy: Unavailable metrics remain UNKNOWN; no100.x direct-route inference
realHost.privacy: No existing user files, clipboard, private UI, raw service logs or preferences
